package.command.continueInLocalClone: Clone Repository Locally and Open on Desktop...
package.command.continueInLocalClone.qualifiedNa: Continue Working in New Local Clone
package.command.blameToggleStatusBarItem: Toggle Git Blame Status Bar Item
package.config.path: Path and filename of the git executable, e.g. `C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe` (Windows). This can also be an array of string values containing multiple paths to look up.
package.config.autoRepositoryDetection: Configures when repositories should be automatically detected.
package.config.autoRepositoryDetection.true: Scan for both subfolders of the current opened folder and parent folders of open files.
package.config.autoRepositoryDetection.subFolder: Scan for subfolders of the currently opened folder.
package.config.autoRepositoryDetection.openEdito: Scan for parent folders of open files.
package.config.autofetch: When set to true, commits will automatically be fetched from the default remote of the current Git repository. Setting to `all` will fetch from all remotes.
package.config.autofetchPeriod: Duration in seconds between each automatic git fetch, when `#git.autofetch#` is enabled.
package.config.confirmCommittedDelete: Confirm before deleting committed files with Git.
package.config.checkoutType: Controls what type of Git refs are listed when running `Checkout to...`.
package.config.defaultBranchName: The name of the default branch (example: main, trunk, development) when initializing a new Git repository. When set to empty, the default branch name configured in Git will be used. **Note:** Requires Git version `2.28.0` or later.
package.config.branchPrefix: Prefix used when creating a new branch.
package.config.branchProtection: List of protected branches. By default, a prompt is shown before changes are committed to a protected branch. The prompt can be controlled using the `#git.branchProtectionPrompt#`  setting.
package.config.branchProtectionPrompt: Controls whether a prompt is being shown before changes are committed to a protected branch.
package.config.branchProtectionPrompt.alwaysComm: Always commit changes to the protected branch.
Always commit changes to a new branch.
package.config.branchProtectionPrompt.alwaysProm: Always prompt before changes are committed to a protected branch.
package.config.branchRandomNameDictionary: List of dictionaries used for the randomly generated branch name. Each value represents the dictionary used to generate the segment of the branch name. Supported dictionaries: `adjectives`, `animals`, `colors` and `numbers`.
package.config.branchRandomNameEnable: Controls whether a random name is generated when creating a new branch.
package.config.branchValidationRegex: A regular expression to validate new branch names.
package.config.branchWhitespaceChar: The character to replace whitespace in new branch names, and to separate segments of a randomly generated branch name.
package.config.ignoreMissingGitWarning: Ignores the warning when Git is missing.
package.config.ignoreWindowsGit27Warning: Ignores the warning when Git 2.25 - 2.26 is installed on Windows.
package.config.ignoreLimitWarning: Ignores the warning when there are too many changes in a repository.
package.config.ignoreRebaseWarning: Ignores the warning when it looks like the branch might have been rebased when pulling.
package.config.defaultCloneDirectory: The default location to clone a Git repository.
package.config.useEditorAsCommitInput: Controls whether a full text editor will be used to author commit messages, whenever no message is provided in the commit input box.
package.config.verboseCommit: Enable verbose output when `#git.useEditorAsCommitInput#` is enabled.
package.config.enableSmartCommit: Commit all changes when there are no staged changes.
package.config.smartCommitChanges: Control which changes are automatically staged by Smart Commit.
package.config.suggestSmartCommit: Suggests to enable smart commit (commit all changes when there are no staged changes).
package.config.enableCommitSigning: Enables commit signing with GPG, X.509, or SSH.
package.config.discardAllScope: Controls what changes are discarded by the `Discard all changes` command. `all` discards all changes. `tracked` discards only tracked files. `prompt` shows a prompt dialog every time the action is run.
package.config.decorations.enabled: Controls whether Git contributes colors and badges to the Explorer and the Open Editors view.
package.config.enableStatusBarSync: Controls whether the Git Sync command appears in the status bar.
package.config.followTagsWhenSync: Push all annotated tags when running the sync command.
package.config.replaceTagsWhenPull: Automatically replace the local tags with the remote tags in case of a conflict when running the pull command.
package.config.promptToSaveFilesBeforeStash: Controls whether Git should check for unsaved files before stashing changes.
package.config.promptToSaveFilesBeforeStash.stag: Check only for unsaved staged files.
package.config.promptToSaveFilesBeforeCommit: Controls whether Git should check for unsaved files before committing.
package.config.promptToSaveFilesBeforeCommit.sta: Check only for unsaved staged files.
package.config.postCommitCommand: Run a git command after a successful commit.
package.config.postCommitCommand.none: Don't run any command after a commit.
package.config.postCommitCommand.push: Run 'git push' after a successful commit.
package.config.postCommitCommand.sync: Run 'git pull' and 'git push' after a successful commit.
package.config.rememberPostCommitCommand: Remember the last git command that ran after a commit.
package.config.openAfterClone: Controls whether to open a repository automatically after cloning.
package.config.openAfterClone.alwaysNewWindow: Always open in a new window.
package.config.openAfterClone.whenNoFolderOpen: Only open in current window when no folder is opened.
package.config.showInlineOpenFileAction: Controls whether to show an inline Open File action in the Git changes view.
package.config.showPushSuccessNotification: Controls whether to show a notification when a push is successful.
package.config.inputValidation: Controls whether to show commit message input validation diagnostics.
package.config.inputValidationLength: Controls the commit message length threshold for showing a warning.
package.config.inputValidationSubjectLength: Controls the commit message subject length threshold for showing a warning. Unset it to inherit the value of `#git.inputValidationLength#`.
package.config.detectSubmodules: Controls whether to automatically detect Git submodules.
package.config.detectSubmodulesLimit: Controls the limit of Git submodules detected.
package.config.detectWorktrees: Controls whether to automatically detect Git worktrees.
package.config.detectWorktreesLimit: Controls the limit of Git worktrees detected.
package.config.worktreeIncludeFiles: Configure patterns, using `.gitignore` syntax, for files and folders that are included when creating a new worktree. Only files and folders that match the patterns and are ignored by git (for example, listed in `.gitignore`) will be copied to the newly created worktree.
package.config.worktreeSymlinkFolders: Configure patterns, using `.gitignore` syntax, for folders to symlink from the current checkout into newly created worktrees. Only folders that match the patterns and are ignored by git (for example, listed in `.gitignore`) will be symlinked. Changes made through a symlink affect the folder in the current checkout.
package.config.alwaysShowStagedChangesResourceGr: Always show the Staged Changes resource group.
package.config.alwaysSignOff: Controls the signoff flag for all commits.
package.config.addAICoAuthor: Controls whether a 'Co-authored-by' trailer is automatically added to the commit message when AI-generated code is included in the commit.
package.config.addAICoAuthor.off: Never add the AI co-author trailer.
package.config.addAICoAuthor.chatAndAgent: Add the AI co-author trailer when code from chat or agent edits is included.
package.config.addAICoAuthor.all: Add the AI co-author trailer when any AI-generated code is included, such as inline completions, chat, or agent edits.
package.config.ignoreSubmodules: Ignore modifications to submodules in the file tree.
package.config.ignoredRepositories: List of Git repositories to ignore.
package.config.scanRepositories: List of paths to search for Git repositories in.

config.commandsToLog.message: List of git commands (ex: commit, push) that would have their `stdout` logged to the [git output](command:git.showOutput). If the git command has a client-side hook configured, the client-side hook's `stdout` will also be logged to the [git output](command:git.showOutput).

package.config.showProgress: Controls whether Git actions should show progress.
package.config.rebaseWhenSync: Force Git to use rebase when running the sync command.
package.config.confirmEmptyCommits: Always confirm the creation of empty commits for the 'Git: Commit Empty' command.
package.config.fetchOnPull: When enabled, fetch all branches when pulling. Otherwise, fetch just the current one.
package.config.pullBeforeCheckout: Controls whether a branch that does not have outgoing commits is fast-forwarded before it is checked out.
package.config.autoStash: Stash any changes before pulling and restore them after successful pull.
package.config.allowForcePush: Controls whether force push (with or without lease) is enabled.
package.config.useForcePushWithLease: Controls whether force pushing uses the safer force-with-lease variant.
package.config.useForcePushIfIncludes: Controls whether force pushing uses the safer force-if-includes variant. Note: This setting requires the `#git.useForcePushWithLease#` setting to be enabled, and Git version `2.30.0` or later.
package.config.confirmForcePush: Controls whether to ask for confirmation before force-pushing.
package.config.allowNoVerifyCommit: Controls whether commits without running pre-commit and commit-msg hooks are allowed.
package.config.confirmNoVerifyCommit: Controls whether to ask for confirmation before committing without verification.
package.config.closeDiffOnOperation: Controls whether the diff editor should be automatically closed when changes are stashed, committed, discarded, staged, or unstaged.
package.config.openDiffOnClick: Controls whether the diff editor should be opened when clicking a change. Otherwise the regular editor will be opened.
package.config.supportCancellation: Controls whether a notification comes up when running the Sync action, which allows the user to cancel the operation.
package.config.branchSortOrder: Controls the sort order for branches.
package.config.untrackedChanges.mixed: All changes, tracked and untracked, appear together and behave equally.
package.config.untrackedChanges.separate: Untracked changes appear separately in the Source Control view. They are also excluded from several actions.
package.config.untrackedChanges.hidden: Untracked changes are hidden and excluded from several actions.
package.config.requireGitUserConfig: Controls whether to require explicit Git user configuration or allow Git to guess if missing.
package.config.showCommitInput: Controls whether to show the commit input in the Git source control panel.
package.config.terminalAuthentication: Controls whether to enable VS Code to be the authentication handler for Git processes spawned in the Integrated Terminal. Note: Terminals need to be restarted to pick up a change in this setting.
package.config.terminalGitEditor: Controls whether to enable VS Code to be the Git editor for Git processes spawned in the integrated terminal. Note: Terminals need to be restarted to pick up a change in this setting.
package.config.timeline.showAuthor: Controls whether to show the commit author in the Timeline view.
package.config.timeline.showUncommitted: Controls whether to show uncommitted changes in the Timeline view.
package.config.timeline.date: Controls which date to use for items in the Timeline view.
package.config.useCommitInputAsStashMessage: Controls whether to use the message from the commit input box as the default stash message.
package.config.showActionButton: Controls whether an action button is shown in the Source Control view.
package.config.showActionButton.commit: Show an action button to commit changes when the local branch has modified files ready to be committed.
package.config.showActionButton.publish: Show an action button to publish the local branch when it does not have a tracking remote branch.
package.config.showActionButton.sync: Show an action button to synchronize changes when the local branch is either ahead or behind the remote branch.
package.config.statusLimit: Controls how to limit the number of changes that can be parsed from Git status command. Can be set to 0 for no limit.
package.config.experimental.installGuide: Experimental improvements for the Git setup flow.
package.config.repositoryScanIgnoredFolders: List of folders that are ignored while scanning for Git repositories when `#git.autoRepositoryDetection#` is set to `true` or `subFolders`.
package.config.repositoryScanMaxDepth: Controls the depth used when scanning workspace folders for Git repositories when `#git.autoRepositoryDetection#` is set to `true` or `subFolders`. Can be set to `-1` for no limit.
package.config.useIntegratedAskPass: Controls whether GIT_ASKPASS should be overwritten to use the integrated version.
package.config.mergeEditor: Open the merge editor for files that are currently under conflict.
package.config.optimisticUpdate: Controls whether to optimistically update the state of the Source Control view after running git commands.
package.config.openRepositoryInParentFolders: Control whether a repository in parent folders of workspaces or open files should be opened.
package.config.openRepositoryInParentFolders.alw: Always open a repository in parent folders of workspaces or open files.
package.config.openRepositoryInParentFolders.nev: Never open a repository in parent folders of workspaces or open files.
package.config.openRepositoryInParentFolders.pro: Prompt before opening a repository the parent folders of workspaces or open files.
package.config.publishBeforeContinueOn: Controls whether to publish unpublished Git state when using Continue Working On from a Git repository.
package.config.publishBeforeContinueOn.always: Always publish unpublished Git state when using Continue Working On from a Git repository
package.config.publishBeforeContinueOn.never: Never publish unpublished Git state when using Continue Working On from a Git repository
package.config.publishBeforeContinueOn.prompt: Prompt to publish unpublished Git state when using Continue Working On from a Git repository
package.config.similarityThreshold: Controls the threshold of the similarity index (the amount of additions/deletions compared to the file's size) for changes in a pair of added/deleted files to be considered a rename. **Note:** Requires Git version `2.18.0` or later.
package.config.blameEditorDecoration.enabled: Controls whether to show blame information in the editor using editor decorations.
package.config.blameEditorDecoration.template:
Template for the blame information editor decoration. Supported variables:

* `hash`: Commit hash

* `hashShort`: First N characters of the commit hash according to `#git.commitShortHashLength#`

* `subject`: First line of the commit message

* `authorName`: Author name

* `authorEmail`: Author email

* `authorDate`: Author date

* `authorDateAgo`: Time difference between now and the author date
package.config.blameEditorDecoration.disableHove: Controls whether to disable the blame information editor decoration hover.
package.config.blameStatusBarItem.enabled: Controls whether to show blame information in the status bar.
package.config.blameStatusBarItem.template:
Template for the blame information status bar item. Supported variables:

* `hash`: Commit hash

* `hashShort`: First N characters of the commit hash according to `#git.commitShortHashLength#`

* `subject`: First line of the commit message

* `authorName`: Author name

* `authorEmail`: Author email

* `authorDate`: Author date

* `authorDateAgo`: Time difference between now and the author date
package.config.blameIgnoreWhitespace: Controls whether to ignore whitespace changes when computing blame information.
package.config.commitShortHashLength: Controls the length of the commit short hash.
package.config.diagnosticsCommitHook.enabled: Controls whether to check for unresolved diagnostics before committing.
package.config.diagnosticsCommitHook.sources: Controls the list of sources (**Item**) and the minimum severity (**Value**) to be considered before committing. **Note:** To ignore diagnostics from a particular source, add the source to the list and set the minimum severity to `none`.
package.config.discardUntrackedChangesToTrash: Controls whether discarding untracked changes moves the file(s) to the Recycle Bin (Windows), Trash (macOS, Linux) instead of deleting them permanently. **Note:** This setting has no effect when connected to a remote or when running in Linux as a snap package.
package.config.showReferenceDetails: Controls whether to show the details of the last commit for Git refs in the checkout, branch, and tag pickers.
package.colors.stageModified: Color for modified resources which have been staged.
package.colors.stageDeleted: Color for deleted resources which have been staged.
package.colors.renamed: Color for renamed or copied resources.
package.colors.blameEditorDecoration: Color for the blame editor decoration.
